title: Towards green, scalable peptide synthesis: leveraging DEG-crosslinked polystyrene resins to overcome hydrophobicity challenges
content:

DEG-crosslinked polystyrene (PS) resin is a promising alternative to traditional DVB-PS resin for solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS), especially for challenging hydrophobic or bulky sequences.
